culture-cycles.note: Bank holidays notified for the RBI Chennai office for 2026; state government offices usually close on these days too, but the state's own gazette list can differ. Where RBI shows several festival names for one day, the label lists all of them; the one that applies here is the festival observed in this state. Dates before 5 November 2026 have passed; replace with the 2027 list when RBI publishes it. Lunar and Islamic dates move each year.

layers.process: Group of Monuments at Mamallapuram: the Archaeological Survey of India lists this monument among its ticketed sites. Check the relevant entrance, price, ticket availability, local opening hours and any applicable exemptions with the monument authority before a visit; the listing alone does not confirm that the site is open.

laws.rule: Under the Tamil Nadu Liquor (Possession for Personal Consumption) Rules 1996, rule 2 (table as amended in 2017), no one may possess more than these amounts for personal consumption: 4.5 litres of Indian made foreign spirits, 4.5 litres of foreign liquor, 7.8 litres of beer, or 9 litres of wine. The Rules are made under section 54 of the Tamil Nadu Prohibition Act 1937.
